question: A marketer discusses a campaign brief with Claude in Chat A inside a project, but Claude does not recall those details when the marketer opens a new Chat B in the same project. What most likely explains this?
options: A) The brief was only discussed in Chat A and was never added to the project's shared knowledge base
B) The project has already reached its maximum allowed number of chats for the current billing cycle
C) Project instructions must be re-saved before any new chat can access prior chat conversations
D) The marketer's current account plan does not permit more than one chat inside each project
correct_answers: A) The brief was only discussed in Chat A and was never added to the project's shared knowledge base
explanations: Correct. Context is not shared across chats in a project unless it has been added to the project knowledge base; discussion in one chat alone stays local to that chat.
Incorrect. There is no documented per-billing-cycle cap on the number of chats within a project that would explain this behavior.
Incorrect. Re-saving project instructions has no bearing on whether one chat's conversation content is visible to another chat.
Incorrect. Plans do not restrict a project to a single chat; multiple chats within one project are expected and supported.
